scientific_boundary: These figures establish or illustrate standard quantum-mechanical structure. They do not establish that consciousness is quantum, that consciousness is a new physical dimension, or that quantum formalism is incomplete.

figures.title: Free Gaussian wavepacket spreading
figures.equation: i hbar d_t psi = -(hbar^2/2m) d_x^2 psi
figures.fact: A minimum-uncertainty free Gaussian broadens because different momentum components acquire different phases.
figures.status: Exact free-particle Gaussian solution in dimensionless units

figures.title: Infinite square-well eigenstates
figures.equation: E_n = n^2 pi^2 hbar^2/(2mL^2), psi_n=sqrt(2/L) sin(n pi x/L)
figures.fact: Boundary conditions discretize the allowed stationary energies and eigenmodes.

figures.title: Double-slit interference
figures.fact: Amplitude superposition produces interference fringes whose visibility is constrained by the single-slit envelope.

figures.title: Heisenberg uncertainty frontier
figures.fact: Gaussian minimum-uncertainty states saturate the boundary while squeezing trades position variance against momentum variance.

figures.title: Bloch-sphere state geometry
figures.equation: rho = (I + r dot sigma)/2; pure states satisfy |r|=1
figures.fact: A qubit density matrix maps to a Bloch vector; pure states lie on the unit sphere and mixed states lie inside it.

figures.title: Born probabilities
figures.fact: Measurement probabilities are squared projection amplitudes and sum to one for a complete projective measurement.
figures.status: Standard Born rule for a pure qubit

figures.title: Rabi oscillations
figures.fact: A resonantly driven two-level system exchanges population coherently between basis states.

figures.title: Pure-dephasing coherence decay
figures.fact: Pure dephasing suppresses off-diagonal density-matrix coherence while leaving basis populations unchanged.

figures.title: Purity under dephasing
figures.fact: The initial pure state approaches a basis-dephased mixed state with purity one half.

figures.title: Von Neumann entropy
figures.fact: For eigenvalues p and 1-p, entropy is zero for a pure state and one bit for a maximally mixed qubit.

figures.title: Two-qubit entanglement entropy
figures.fact: The reduced-state entropy is zero for product states and reaches one bit at maximal entanglement.

figures.title: Bell-CHSH correlation
figures.fact: Entangled quantum correlations can violate the local hidden-variable CHSH bound without permitting superluminal signalling.

figures.title: Wigner-function negativity
figures.equation: W_1(x,p)=(2 r^2-1) exp(-r^2)/pi in the chosen scaling
figures.fact: The first excited harmonic-oscillator state has a negative central Wigner region, a nonclassical quasiprobability feature.

figures.title: Hilbert-space dimension scaling
figures.fact: The state-vector dimension of N qubits grows exponentially with subsystem count.

figures.title: Quantum distinguishability contraction
figures.fact: Depolarizing noise contracts operational distinguishability, directly paralleling classical data-processing loss under coarse descriptions.

figures.title: Pure-state fidelity and trace distance
figures.fact: Pure states become less faithful and more distinguishable as their projective angle increases.

figures.title: Quantum Zeno effect
figures.fact: In the ideal projective limit, increasingly frequent survival measurements suppress coherent transition away from the initial state.

figures.title: Reduced-state spectrum under partial trace
figures.fact: A globally pure entangled state can induce a mixed local reduced state after tracing out its partner.
figures.status: Standard partial-trace result for a Schmidt pair
